caption: The video captures a daylight view of a frozen cliff, where a dense curtain of pale icicles hangs from an overhang into a sheet of ice. A thick bright ice column at center-right drops toward a base piled with snow and rounded chunks of frozen water. A slope of dry brown grass flecked with snow runs along the left, while a layered grey rock wall fills the right. Across the excerpt the framing and lighting stay broadly consistent with slight drift, and the icicles, ice column, snow piles and slope remain in place. No falling ice or deformation is apparent, so the frozen waterfall simply persists in its built-up state. The scene stays composed on the same stretch of cliff, presenting the standing ice as a settled formation.
